sentence_1_it: Entrambi i miei genitori erano disoccupati, ma non lasciò che ciò impedisse loro di accudire adeguatamente me e i miei ventitré fratelli e sorelle.
sentence_1_en: Both of my parents were unemployed, but they didn't let that stop them from properly looking after me and my 23 brothers and sisters.
